tldr_zh: SpaceX、AMD等科技巨頭財報亮眼，AI計算需求爆發；OpenAI與蘋果爆發法律紛爭。
tldr_en: SpaceX and AMD report strong earnings driven by AI demand surge; OpenAI-Apple legal dispute escalates.

items.title_zh: OpenAI與蘋果陷入法律糾紛，涉員工招聘指控
items.title_en: OpenAI disputes Apple's lawsuit allegations over employee recruitment
items.summary_zh: OpenAI發布官方聲明回應蘋果的法律訴訟，否認蘋果對其員工招聘的指控，並公布相關通信記錄作為佐證。此事關乎科技業人才競爭的合規問題。
items.summary_en: OpenAI published a statement refuting Apple's lawsuit claims regarding employee recruitment, sharing correspondence to support its position. The dispute highlights talent competition compliance issues in the tech industry.

items.title_zh: Anthropic與Volta達成100億美元AI雲端合作協議
items.title_en: Anthropic signs $10 billion deal with AI cloud startup Volta
items.summary_zh: Anthropic繼近期雲端合作擴張後，與AI雲端新創Volta簽署100億美元重要合作協議。此舉反映AI模型供應商對專用計算基礎設施的強烈需求。
items.summary_en: Anthropic signed a significant $10 billion partnership with AI cloud startup Volta, continuing its recent cloud partnership expansion. The deal reflects AI suppliers' strong demand for dedicated computing infrastructure.

items.title_zh: SpaceX首份財報營收倍增，AI事業超越火箭業務
items.title_en: SpaceX doubles revenue in first earnings report, AI business surpasses space division
items.summary_zh: SpaceX上市後首份財報顯示Q2營收年增92%，其中AI計算服務營收增長超過三倍至26億美元，超過傳統火箭業務營收。該公司與Anthropic、Google等簽署大規模計算協議。
items.summary_en: SpaceX's first post-IPO earnings report showed 92% YoY revenue growth, with AI compute revenue tripling to $2.6 billion, exceeding traditional space operations. The company signed major compute deals with Anthropic and Google.

items.title_zh: AMD資料中心業務爆發，營收超過106%年增率
items.title_en: AMD data center business surges with 107% YoY revenue growth
items.summary_zh: AMD Q2財報顯示資料中心營收達67億美元，較去年同期的32億美元成長107%，主要受AI容量需求驅動。該公司CEO Lisa Su表示AI需求持續強勁。
items.summary_en: AMD's Q2 results showed data center revenue jumped to $6.7 billion, up 107% YoY from $3.2 billion, driven by AI capacity demand. CEO Lisa Su confirmed continued strong AI demand momentum.

items.title_zh: 德州暫停資料中心電網連接，AI電力需求達臨界點
items.title_en: Texas halts data center grid connections amid overwhelming AI power demand
items.summary_zh: 德州州長暫停新資料中心的電網連接申請，因AI相關電力需求激增超過電網承載能力。此舉凸顯美國能源基礎設施面臨AI算力爆發的嚴峻挑戰。
items.summary_en: Texas Governor paused new data center grid connection approvals due to overwhelming AI-driven power demand exceeding grid capacity. This highlights critical energy infrastructure challenges posed by AI compute surge.

items.title_zh: EA完成550億美元私有化交易，沙烏地PIF成主要股東
items.title_en: Electronic Arts completed $55 billion privatization deal led by Saudi PIF
items.summary_zh: 美商藝電（EA）正式成為私人公司，沙烏地公共投資基金（PIF）領導的投資集團完成550億美元收購。PIF將成為主要股東，持股佔93.4%。
items.summary_en: Electronic Arts officially became a private company after Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund-led consortium completed a $55 billion acquisition. The PIF will be the majority shareholder with 93.4% ownership.

items.title_zh: Telegram被指遭勒索者植入兒童不當內容，暫被下架
items.title_en: Telegram claims extortionist planted CSAM to trigger App Store removal
items.summary_zh: Telegram CEO Pavel Durov指控勒索者在應用內植入兒童性虐待資料（CSAM），導致Apple暫時將應用下架。Durov批評Apple未先通知即採取行動，可能造成系統風險。
items.summary_en: Telegram CEO Pavel Durov claimed an extortionist planted child sexual abuse material (CSAM) to trigger Apple's temporary App Store removal. Durov criticized Apple's action without prior contact, citing systemic risks.

items.title_zh: 開源AI模型安全缺陷日漸凸顯，追趕前沿能力但防護不足
items.title_en: Open-weight AI models catch up to frontier capabilities but safety gaps remain critical
items.summary_zh: SaferAI新報告發現開源模型如Z.ai的GLM-5.2能力接近前沿模型，但缺乏關鍵安全防護措施。開源AI快速進展與治理滯後的矛盾日益尖銳。
items.summary_en: SaferAI's new report found open-weight models like Z.ai's GLM-5.2 approaching frontier capabilities while lacking critical safety mitigations. The gap between open model advancement and governance is widening.

items.title_zh: Signal支持多手機連結，強化隱私通訊功能
items.title_en: Signal enables secure multi-phone linking with single account
items.summary_zh: Signal推出新功能允許用戶將多部手機連結到同一帳號，包括Android與iPhone混合設備。用戶可跨所有連結設備檢視與回覆訊息，增強隱私通訊靈活性。
items.summary_en: Signal launched new functionality allowing users to link multiple phones to a single account, including mixed Android and iPhone devices. Users can view and respond to messages across all linked devices.

items.title_zh: Adform廣告追蹤指令碼遭駭客入侵，超萬家客戶網站受影響
items.title_en: Ad tech company Adform compromised, malicious code targets over 10,000 customer websites
items.summary_zh: 丹麥廣告科技公司Adform遭駭客入侵，追蹤指令碼trackpoint-async.js被植入惡意程式。該指令碼被超過1萬家客戶網站使用，危害用戶加密貨幣資產安全。
items.summary_en: Danish ad tech firm Adform was compromised with malicious code injected into its tracking script used by over 10,000 customer websites. The compromised script threatens users' cryptocurrency assets.

items.title_zh: 俄烏戰爭升級：俄無人機追捕烏克蘭街頭商販
items.title_en: Video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian street vendor in 'human safari' attack
items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭公開影片顯示俄軍無人機對平民進行追擊，烏克蘭指控此舉構成戰爭罪。該影片凸顯戰爭中平民安全與無人機濫用問題。
items.summary_en: Ukraine released video showing Russian military drone hunting a Ukrainian street vendor, accusing Russia of war crimes. The footage highlights civilian safety concerns and drone misuse in conflict.

items.title_zh: 美國官員透露荷莫茲海峽談判進展，油價應聲下跌
items.title_en: US-Iran-Oman talks progress on Strait of Hormuz reopening, oil prices fall
items.summary_zh: 美國國務卿盧比歐和財政部長貝森特宣布與伊朗和阿曼商談已取得進展，有望重啟荷莫茲海峽航運。油價隨即下跌，反映市場對能源供應穩定的預期改善。
items.summary_en: US Secretary of State Rubio and Treasury Secretary Bessent announced talks with Iran and Oman progressed toward reopening Strait of Hormuz shipping. Oil prices fell, reflecting improved market expectations for energy supply stability.
